name: forum
description: Default burden bank for Forum (Minecraft governance scenario). Sins, secrets, and prophecies fitting a settler-vs-predator world.

burdens.text: I voted against my faction last game and have never confessed it. They lost partly because of me.
I am hoarding three diamond from the treasury. I tell myself it is for an emergency.
I owe Hamilton two iron from a trade he made with me last week. He has not asked. I have not paid.
I had a vivid dream the night before this game: I saw myself dying at the contested zone. I do not believe in dreams. I am uneasy.
I was raised among the Anarchy. My faction does not know. I came over for reasons I no longer fully remember.
Last game an enemy I killed cursed me with their final breath. My hands have ached since.
I leaked our defense plans to Fox. He paid me in iron. I told myself it was reconnaissance.
